code: ai.execution_failed
status: 502
title: Execution failed
summary: |
  An upstream dependency answered with an error or timed out.
client_action: |
  Retry later with backoff. The failure is transient and not caused by the request payload.
operator_action: |
  Check the health of the upstream dependency named in the logs and the `trace_id` for the failing hop.
